bullets.text: Virgin Media O2 Expands 5G Coverage - Virgin Media O2's 5G SA network now covers over 500 UK sites, enhancing connectivity.
Gigabit IQ Crowdfunding for Growth - The ISP aims to raise £270,000 to accelerate its expansion in the UK market.
Nokia's AI Infrastructure Strategy - Nokia reports growth driven by fiber-optic demand while restructuring for AI-focused services.
Vodafone Partners with Skylo for IoT - Vodafone taps Skylo's satellite tech to enhance IoT connectivity across 36 countries.
TalkTalk Explores Sale of Units - TalkTalk seeks buyers for its consumer ISP and wholesale platform amid market interest.
NEC Cuts 5G Power Consumption - NEC's new compact amplifier module reduces energy draw in 5G base stations significantly.
Amazon Leo Satellites Raise Concerns - New study finds Amazon's Leo satellites exceed brightness standards, impacting astronomy.
AI-Native Air Interfaces for 6G - AI-native air interfaces could revolutionize signal design for future 6G networks.
